heroes: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: TRANSPARENT sprite atlas for a 2D mobile jumping game. The reference image is the approved art direction. Draw high quality intricately inked and gouache painted chibi hiking girl with flowing dark brown hair, teal green jacket, red neckerchief, olive green backpack, brown hiking boots, cream skin; match reference character closely. Full body facing RIGHT in all cells. Exact regular 6 COLUMNS x 3 ROWS grid, 18 isolated sprites, each fully inside its equal cell with generous transparent margin, feet aligned. Each COLUMN is one costume, each ROW is one animation pose. Columns left to right: 1 classic teal hiker; 2 same girl blue cap and blue jacket researcher; 3 same girl orange fox ear hood teal jacket; 4 same girl red wool beanie and red scarf; 5 same girl cream bear ear hood; 6 same girl dark owl hood and round glasses. Row1 standing relaxed. Row2 airborne rising with knees tucked, hair trailing behind. Row3 airborne falling with legs extended and arms out. EVERY cell shows exactly one entire character. Maintain same proportions and detailed storybook brush texture across all costumes and poses, dark warm outline, natural organic silhouettes. No platform, no floor, no shadows, no scenery, no words, no letters, no numbers, no frames, no grid lines. Genuinely transparent background. This is production game artwork, not an interface mockup. Landscape sheet approximately 1536x1024.

ruined_mine_background: Use case: illustration-story. Production portrait 2D jumping game background, approximately 390:760 aspect ratio. Use the attached image ONLY as the approved hand-inked gouache adventure-game visual style. Show a devastated FICTIONAL Armenian mountain mine at the start of a restoration story: grey ochre broken cliff faces, abandoned rusted conveyors and pipes at extreme left and right edges, cracked cyanide-processing drums with no labels at bottom corners, polluted amber and murky yellow-green trickles down rubble, leafless burnt shrubs, overcast dusty grey sky, distant excavated mountain. Bleak post-apocalyptic environmental mood but suitable for a friendly illustrated adventure, no gore, no people or animals. MAIN REQUIREMENT: very quiet visual composition, large uninterrupted softly painted open central and upper sky taking 65% of picture, detailed rubble and machinery only at bottom 25% and narrow edge margins. Low contrast muted earth colors, soft distant scenery, no black-heavy outlines in center, no crowded textures. Keep the exact reference storybook ink/gouache medium, not photographic and not flat geometric vector. No game UI, no platforms, no words, no letters, no player, no icons, no watermarks. Environment is a symbolic fictional mine, not documentary photography.
